notes: Fresh Sep 6 Toronto-morning B_V1 gate over all 169 judge candidates. All candidates were reviewed for entity accuracy and the five B_V1 dimensions. The pool contained unusually heavy accidental ticker mappings and evergreen/valuation repackaging, so those were hard-rejected. Semantically duplicate angles were merged. Six distinct events cleared the gate; fewer than 20 were kept rather than padding or wasting YouTube search quota.
